description.value: The Cortes Island branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has been housed in the former school building at Linnaea Farm since 2013, serving this remote Gulf Island community. Situated on unceded Klahoose First Nation territory, it offers an expanded collection and friendly staff to both locals and visitors. For touring cyclists making the ferry crossing to Cortes Island, it is one of the few public facilities in Manson's Landing.
